props.gloss_en: R' Yosei bar Chanina: [items unequal in their measures] do not join to the stricter among them, but they do join to the more lenient among them
and the sack: four by four
and the hide: five by five
the garment and the sack, the sack and the hide, the hide and the mat join with one another
R' Shimon: what is the reason [they join]? because they are fit to become impure as a seat
the reason [they join] is that they are fit to become impure as a seat; but what is not fit to become impure as a seat -- no [it does not join]
Rava: here too, it is fit for a sample [so the lenient-joining has a shared basis]

supports.gloss_en: טעמא דראויין ליטמא מושב -- since R' Shimon gives fitness for seat-impurity as the reason, without it they would not join
